title: doPlan: A Variable-Horizon Dataset for Multi-Stage Language-Conditioned Planning in Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2609.38028v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous vehicles interacting with passengers through natural language must reason beyond immediate commands. Passenger intent may span multiple stages of behavior, depend on future events, refer to surrounding agents or landmarks, and remain relevant as driving conditions evolve. Existing language-enabled driving datasets largely focus on short, localized interactions, leaving these longer-horizon forms of passenger intent comparatively underexplored. We introduce doPlan, to our knowledge the first publicly available, human-annotated real-world dataset designed to study passenger language as persistent task context. Built on nuPlan, doPlan contains 5,154 human-written passenger instructions spanning 169.1 hours of cumulative instruction-aligned context over 50.9 hours of unique driving, with annotation windows ranging from 30.0 to 508.8 s. translated_title: doPlan：一个用于自动驾驶中多阶段语言条件规划的变时域数据集
translated_abstract: 通过自然语言与乘客互动的自动驾驶车辆必须超越即时指令进行推理。乘客意图可能跨越多个行为阶段、依赖于未来事件、涉及周围的交通参与者或地标，并随着驾驶条件的演变而保持相关。现有的语言驱动数据集主要关注简短、局部的交互，使得这类较长时域的乘客意图形式相对缺乏探索。我们提出了doPlan，据我们所知，这是首个公开可用的、人工标注的真实世界数据集，旨在将乘客语言作为持续性任务上下文进行研究。doPlan基于nuPlan构建，包含5,154条人工撰写的乘客指令，在50.9小时的独特驾驶里程中涵盖累计169.1小时的与指令对齐的上下文，标注窗口范围从30.0秒到508.8秒。这些标注捕捉了即时、延迟、事件条件、持续和多阶段类型的乘客意图。
tldr: 提出doPlan——首个公开可用的、基于人工标注真实驾驶数据的数据集，将乘客语言作为持续性任务上下文，支持自动驾驶中长时域、多阶段的语言条件规划研究。
en_tdlr: Introduces doPlan, the first publicly available human-annotated real-world dataset that treats passenger language as persistent task context, enabling long-horizon, multi-stage language-conditioned planning research in autonomous driving.
